_comment: Frostpeak parent terrain: a copy of the base 'highplains' generator but with a much wider interpolation horizontalScale (32 vs 15) so the Frostpeak plateau's height blends GRADUALLY into neighbouring biomes (e.g. plains) instead of jumping at the biome edge. Same composite shape as highplains, only the interpolation reach is widened. (We do not edit highplains itself - it is shared by other biomes.) The cliffHeight* block terraces the otherwise-noisy plateau into flat, mesa-like steps (same mechanism as base 'cracked-cliffs'): a CELLULAR_HEIGHT generator quantises the height into broad flat cells separated by sharp cliffs, so the summit reads as layered shelves instead of continuous noise.
